name: Caravaggio
bio: Italian painter whose intense and unsettling realism, combined with dramatic theatrical lighting (tenebrism), exerted a decisive influence on Baroque painting.
bioPl: Włoski malarz, którego przejmujący realizm powiązany z dramatycznym światłocieniem (tenebryzmem) wywarł decydujący wpływ na sztukę baroku.
notableWorks: David with the Head of Goliath

catalog.title: The Calling of Saint Matthew
catalog.location: Contarelli Chapel, San Luigi dei Francesi, Rome
catalog.description: Masterpiece of tenebrism showing Christ calling Matthew out of a dark tavern with a beam of divine light.

catalog.title: Judith Beheading Holofernes
catalog.description: Dramatic depiction of the biblical heroine Judith severing Holofernes' head.

catalog.title: David with the Head of Goliath
catalog.description: Late dramatic masterpiece featuring Caravaggio's own self-portrait in the severed head of Goliath.
